# hostwarden_host_ntp (Resource)

NTP configuration of an ESXi host. Destroying the resource leaves the configuration on the host as it is.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_id` (String)
- `servers` (List of String) NTP servers (names or addresses). At least one is required when enabled.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Synchronise the host clock with the NTP servers (default true).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The host id.
